method: Official earnings releases and primary SEC exhibits. Every recap states revenue growth versus the same quarter last year and explains guidance changes. Raises compare the same measure and forecast period; new-period outlooks are not raises. Missing comparisons are stated. Short editorial recaps; no beat/miss labels, paid sources or transcript redistribution.
